title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
description: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.
text: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.
BBC Verify has used air traffic control audio and flight tracking data to reconstruct the final moments before the plane crashed.
Produced by Sophie Bott and Jenna Abaakouk. Graphics by Mark Edwards and Mesut Ersoz.
This video has been edited due to lack of clarity in one section of audio.
